=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI SO recruitment 2026: Registration window open for 77 Specialist Officer posts, apply by November 25 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• Document Verification .

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• RRB NTPC Apply Online 2026 Started Now, Check Application Link, Fee and Last Date : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UCO Bank Apprentice Exam Date 2026 Out, Check Selection Process, Exam Pattern, and Syllabus for 530 Vacancy : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (530 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• NTA CSIR UGC NET December : Candidates must have passed or appeared in a Master’s Degree examination in the relevant subject with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized university or institution.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (STATE PSC CIVIL) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.

• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)

• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• US Midterms: What the Result Could Mean for Trump, Ukraine and Europe : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes

• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO : 350 Posts
• Indian Bank Specialist Officer SO : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree / Master’s degree / CA / B.Tech from a recognized university or institute. For post-wise eligibility and experience details , candidates should read the official notification carefully.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written Test Screening Personal Interview Final Merit List Proficiency in Local Language Final Selection
• Personal Interview

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Bihar BPSC AES : 17 Post
• Bihar BPSC AES : Candidates must have Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Life Science, Environmental Science, or Physics from a recognized university/institution. For full details, refer to the official notification.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written Exam Interview
• Written Exam

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB NTPC UG CBTST Admit Card 2026, Download Hall Ticket : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• 4. plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSC Mains 2026 Exam Date, Schedule, Syllabus, Exam Pattern : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• CBT (Tier-I Exam, Tier-II Exam) Document Verification Merit List
• CBT (Tier-I Exam, Tier-II Exam)
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• Management Trainee (Personnel & Administration) : Candidates must have a Graduate with (55% Marks) and 02 Years MBA/MSW or Equivalent PG Degree or Diploma with specialization in HRM/ Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations with (60% Marks).
• Assistant Officer (Commercial & Operations) : Candidates must have a Graduate with (50% Marks) and 04 Years Experience OR 2 Years (for candidates having Institute of Rail Transport Diploma in multi modal transport or any other special course of minimum one year in shipping/logistics/ Trade along with qualification as mentioned above).
• Assistant Officer (Accounts) : Candidates must have a B. Com with (50% Marks) and 04 Years Experience OR 2 Years (for candidates qualified in CA(Inter)/CMA (Inter) along with qualification as mentioned above.
• Assistant Officer (Technical) : Candidates must have a Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics with (50% Marks) and 3 Years Experience for candidates having diploma OR 1 Year (for candidates having Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Mechanical/ Electrical/Civil/Electronics with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from any university or institute duly approved by Govt / recognized by AICTE/ UGC).
• Assistant Officer (MIS) : Candidates must have a Graduate with PGDCA or BCA or B.Sc (Hons) in Computer Science or DOEACC ‘A’ Level with (50% Marks) and 3 Years Experience (in IT support, software applications in reputed company), OR 1 Year (for candidates having MCA Degree/B.Tech/ BE (Computer Science/Computer Engg.)/ M.Sc (IT)/ M.Sc (Computer Science)/ DOEACC B level with minimum 50% marks).

• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===

Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Junior Engineer JE : General (EWS)
• 1714 : 398 (919)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Find the notice related to RRB JE Exam Date 2026 / CBT-2 Exam Schedule .
• CBT 1 CBT 2 Document Verification Medical Examination
• Document Verification
• Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Assistant Officer : Candidates must have a Graduation Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized University/Institute. They must also possess a full-time 2-year Post Graduate Degree. PG Diploma in a relevant field , such as Mass Communication, Journalism, Advertising & Communication, Public Relations, or a combination thereof , with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institute. For more details, candidates should read the official notification.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Primary Level Class 1-5 : Candidates must have 10+2 Intermediate / Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and must have passed or be appearing in the final year of a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (B.T.C. / D.El.Ed.) , or 10+2 with at least 45% marks with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (as per NCTE 2002 norms) . Alternatively, candidates may have 10+2 with at least 50% marks and be appearing in the final year of a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) , or 10+2 with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) . Candidates with a Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) and passed or appearing in the final year of a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (B.T.C. / D.El.Ed.) are also eligible.
• Junior Level Class 6-8 : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) and must have passed or be appearing in the final year of a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (B.T.C. / D.El.Ed.) , or a Bachelor’s Degree with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in the final year of B.Ed. / L.T. / Shiksha Shastri (Regular) . Candidates with a Bachelor’s Degree with at least 45% marks and B.Ed. (as per NCTE norms) are also eligible. Alternatively, candidates who have 10+2 Intermediate / Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and are appearing in the final year of a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) , or a 4-year B.A./B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed program are eligible. Candidates with a Bachelor’s Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. (Special Education) , or those having a Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks along with a 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. course , are also eligible. For more details, candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully .

• Written Exam Merit List Document Verification Final Selection
• Written Exam
• Document Verification

• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | Combined
• 2. Language-I & Language-II | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | 150 Minutes
• 3. Domain Subject (Maths/Science/Social/TGT/PGT) | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | (2.5 Hours)
• Total | 150 Qs | 150 Marks | 150 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (OMR / CBT)
• Focus Area: NEP 2020, NCF, Inclusive Education, Pedagogy & Subject Mastery

• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy: Theories of Piaget, Vygotsky & Kohlberg, Concept of Inclusive Education & Special Needs, NEP 2020, RTE Act 2009 & NCF Guidelines, Assessment, Evaluation & Learning Motivation
• 2. Language-I & II (Hindi/English): Unseen Prose & Poetry Comprehension, Principles of Language Teaching & Acquisition, Grammar, Vocabulary, Figures of Speech & Remedial Teaching
• 3. Concerned Subject & GS: NCERT/SCERT Core Subject Syllabus (Class 6 to 12 Level), Indian National Movement, Polity, Geography & Environment, Basic Arithmetic, Reasoning & Current Affairs

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• NVS Class VI Admission 2026 : Eligibility Criteria (As per Notice)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Constable : 1161 (The candidate must have passed the 10th Standard (Matriculation) or equivalent from a recognized board.)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• PET / PST Date : 26 September 2025
• Trade Test & DV Start : From 11 December 2025
• Trade Test & DV Admit Card : 02 December 2025
• Written Examination Document Verification Physical Test
• Written Examination
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSSSC PET Answer Key 2026 Out at upsssc.gov.in, PDF डाउनलोड करें, 8 नवंबर तक आपत्ति दर्ज करें : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CGL Tier 1 provisional answer key out today : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CGL Tier I Answer Key 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, raise objection till November 7 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in, Download Response Sheet & Objection Link : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)

• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• Stage 1: Written Objective Examination (Child Pedagogy, Languages & Subject Concerned)

• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | Combined
• 2. Language-I & Language-II | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | 150 Minutes

• 3. Concerned Subject & GS: NCERT/SCERT Core Subject Syllabus (Class 6 to 12 Level), Indian National Movement, Polity, Geography & Environment, Basic Arithmetic, Reasoning & Current Affairs

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSSSC PET Answer Key 2026 (Official): Check UP Preliminary Eligibility Test Response Sheet PDF Shortly at upsssc.gov.in, Expected Date Here : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• PSSSB Group D Answer Key 2026 Out at sssb.punjab.gov.in, Download Set Wise Official Key PDF : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade

Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSC Post List 2026, Salary, Job Profile, 23 Posts Group Wise : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (23 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (STATE PSC CIVIL) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• IBPS RRB PO Syllabus 2026, Exam Pattern for Officer Scale 1 Prelims and Mains : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.
